name: frontierplan
description: Astra-led planning, bounded Worker–Reviewer task pairs without Main relaying ordinary review, and a one-time Astra final check. Luna or Devin SWE-2 workers.

interface.shortDescription: Astra plans; pairs verify; Main integrates and finishes.
interface.longDescription: Explicit-only AstraPlan-herdr, AstraPlan-herdr-swe2 and AstraPlan-subagent. Astra owns pre-implementation decisions; Main relays planning and assigns bounded execution pairs. The same Worker and Sol Reviewer exchange findings/fixes directly; Main collects reviewed work and handles blockers. Astra checks the integrated Plan once, without a veto. Native pairing requires real child-to-peer continuation.
